Robotic Vacuums

To say that vacuum technology has come a long way would be a huge understatement. Today’s modern vacuum cleaner has taken a huge leap into the future with fully autonomous operation, like the Roomba.

Using SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping) technology in conjunction with OMNIVISION’s dynamic, compact sensor solutions and global shutter (GS) technology, Roomba has proven to be an industry leader in home cleaning solutions. OMNIVISION’s aim is to always provide high-quality sensing and imaging solutions that provide safety, convenience and assurance to both OEMs end users.

# Robotic Vacuums

To say that vacuum technology has come a long way would be a huge understatement. Today’s modern vacuum cleaner has taken a huge leap into the future with fully autonomous operation, like the Roomba.

Using SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping) technology in conjunction with OMNIVISION’s dynamic, compact sensor solutions and global shutter (GS) technology, Roomba has proven to be an industry leader in home cleaning solutions. OMNIVISION’s aim is to always provide high-quality sensing and imaging solutions that provide safety, convenience and assurance to both OEMs end users.
